conditions: User has given consent for automatic data collection
effects: Enables or disables the collection of specific device data including GeoIP, device brand, and device model.

conditions: User wants to enable GeoIP resolution, device brand, and model information collection.
effects: User's location can be resolved and the SDK can collect the device brand and model.

conditions: User wants to disable GeoIP resolution, device brand, and model information collection.
effects: GeoIP resolution is not performed and device brand and model data are not collected.
Disables all SDK functionalities including data collection, In-App campaigns, and network capabilities.

conditions: User wants to opt-out from the SDK functionalities.
effects: Prevents any SDK operations and network capabilities.
Wipes local installation data and requests remote data removal for the user's Installation ID.

conditions: User wants to opt-out and delete all associated data.
effects: User-level data associated with the Custom User ID will not be deleted, but Installation ID association will be removed.
Re-enables SDK functionalities and functionalities like Batch.onStart(Activity) must be called.

conditions: User wants to opt-in to SDK functionalities again.
